none: PAS NLM-CDC381: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Valentinian
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy coin. Nummus of House of Valentinian (364-378), Emperor right issue, Reece period 19. Obverse description: Bust draped and diademed right. Reverse description: Emperor advancing right holding labarum and dragging captive. Reverse inscription: [GLORIA ROMANORVM]. Diameter: 15.2mm, Weight: 1.38gms, die axis: probably 12
